tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs dkyus gcig tu bkod pa dri med zla ba'i bsil zer ces bya ba bzhugs so//

/na mo gu ru badz+rā mṛ ta ma hā su khā ya/ /rdo rje nyi mas rtog sgrib mun pa gtor/ /bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud blugs pas/ /skal ldan rnam grol srog gi zungs skyed pa/ /he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i zhal gyis skyongs/ /yon tan bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /gsang sngags gsar rnying dgongs pa 'dus/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba'i/ /smin byed lag khrigs gsal bar bya/ /gangs can tsam na dkon la rin thang che zhing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gsang ba zab mo dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du skal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i slob ma gzhug pa la don gsum/ sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i chos/ dngos gzhi sgrub mchod dbang bskur/ rjes su bya ba'i las kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sa chog /sta gon/ dkyil 'khor dang dbang rdzas 'du bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang gsar pa dang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i phyogs la/ sa chog rgyas pa'am mdor bsdus sgrub khog ltar bya dgos kyang*/ 'dir gnas khang rnying pa ras bris la brten pa'i dbang du byas te/ rten bkram pa'i mdun tu bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi mchod rnams dang*/ dkar gtor gser skyems bsham/ tshig bdun dang brgyud 'debs song nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du+u sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing gnang ba byin par bsam la dkar gtor gser skyems phyi rol du phul bas sa chog gi don grub/

gnyis pa la gsum/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs sems tshogs bsags nas bzung*/ bdag bskyaid bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la stong tshig 'bul/ dbang stegs su bdud rtsis chag chag gdab la me tog gcal du bkram/ sman raka gtor gsum dang phyi mchod phreng tshar du bsham/ hūm̐: gnas yul dur khrod rol pa'i zhing : mchod rdzas bsod nams ye shes rgya: bde ba chen po'i rnam par rol: 'grib med rtag pa'i rgyan du shar: oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sarba pū dza sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: zhes pas byin brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs dkyil 'khor gyi gnas la bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐: rdo rje nyi ma las byung ba: bde chen bdud rtsis dgyes pa can: he ru ka dang btsun mor bcas: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: ma hā su kha dzñā na dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ brda phyag ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje rkang lag mdzes pa'i gar: dga' ba'i glu dang rab tu sbyor: ngo mtshar chen po'i dam tshig gis: rjes su chags pa'i phyag bgyi'o: shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha na mā mi: mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' las byung ye shes sprin: lha yi me tog dmar ba'i mdangs: rdo rje rjes su chags pa'i spos: rin chen gzi ldan sgron ma che: sna tshogs dri zhim bsil ba'i chab: ro bcud nus ldan 'chi med bshos: 'jig rten dge ba'i dam tshig gis: mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: hūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai wi d+yā pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: drug las skyes sogs glu blangs shing : kun tu bzang po'i rol mo che: nam mkha' gang ba'i gar bcas pas:

rdo rje rjes su chags par mdzod: hūm̐ shrī badz+ra rā ga gīrti nīrti shab+da pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lcags kyu lnga yi rgya mtsho che: sha chen lnga dang yang dag ldan: rdo rje gsum dang mnyam sbyor ba: bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi: badz+ra a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mṛ tu sid+dhi ku ru ho: hūm̐: kha dog dri ro nus bcud ldan: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ btud pas bran: 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i: gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: shrī he ru ka rak+ta pi pā hoḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma rgad lhun po'i sku can nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i snang bas khams gsum sad par mdzad: shes rab ma dang mnyam sbyor dpa' mo'i tshogs su spyod: he ru ka dpal btsun mor bcas la phyag 'tshal 'dud: gang zhig yid la dran pas kyang : dngos grub mchog kun stsol mdzad pa: dpal ldan bde chen mgon po kye: bdag la rjes su dgongs par mdzod: sa ma ya sid+dhi a la la hoḥ de nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ dril spos bcas/ oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi bcom ldan 'das: dgyes pa chen po'i lha tshogs kyis: sa gzhi yongs su dag pa dang : bdag dang slob mar byin brlab gsol: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes gsol dgyes pas zhal bzhes shing : dga' ba'i sgrar bcas sa la thim: bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi: ye shes gzi byin 'bar bar gyur: ces mos/ gnyis pa ni/ stegs bu'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings ljang gu dang so lnga'i bcud ldan/ las bum sngon po khrus rdzas sbyor ba/ gnyis ka kha rgyan gzungs thag ldan pa bzhag /mchod gtor sngar ltar bshams pa byin brlab/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang*/ oṃ swā bhā ba bi shud+dho3haṃ: gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng : mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bum pa'i nang : sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan gyi steng :

hūm̐ gi sgra yis skad cig gis: rin chen nyi ma de bzhin gshegs: sogs rtsa ba'i las byang ltar la/ sgo bzhi zhes pa phyogs bzhir zhes bsgyur/ gzhan bstod pa'i bar mthar chags su song nas/ gzungs thag blangs la/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la/ /'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul/ /de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas bum chur dbyer med ro gcig gyur/ ces zhi drag gi bzlas pa sum brgya re las mi nyung ba bzla/ mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥgis mchod yon phul bas/ lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par mos/ dbang chen yongs rdzogs skabs las bum du gzhung 'dir dmigs su bstan pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bskyed bzlas bya dgos pas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen bum pa ni: dag byed bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan dbus: pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ dud ka: 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: rdo rje bdud rtsi yang dag bsdus: thim par gyur las skad cig gis: bcom ldan rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gsum dgra s+t+wa 'bar ba dang : ye shes ral gri rdo rje gdengs: g.yon gsum gdug pa bsdigs mdzad cing : gtun shing 'phyar zhing zhags pa 'phen: zhal gdangs spyan gsum smar smin dang : dbu skra dmar ser rab tu 'bar: khro gtum sku che yan lag rags: spyi bor bdud rtsi'i glegs bam 'chang : stag sham dang ni sbrul gyis brgyan: zhabs zung gyad kyi dor stabs kyis: bgegs kyi rgyal po pho mo mnan: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i dbus: rang 'od rdo rje bdud rtsi ma: khro chags nyams ldan pad+ma dang : bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams pas 'khyud:

thabs dang shes rab snyoms zhugs sgras: ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med bsam: hūm̐: bde gshegs rnams ni thams cad kyi: ye shes rdo rje bdud rtsir 'khyil: sgrib gnyis dri ma sbyong mdzad lha: 'dir ni yang dag nye bar mdzod: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī e h+ye hi: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dga' ba rnam pa bzhi'i: phyag rgyas dgug cing nye bar gzhug: dbyer med dgyes pa chen po yi: dam tshig mchog gi gnas la rol: ma hā su kha dzñā na dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ oṃ: lha yi bdud rtsi dri ma med: ye shes lnga dang yang dag sbyor: byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis: rtog pa'i dri ma sbyang bar bya: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi tsit+ta a mṛ ta trām̐ hūm̐ oṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: bo dhi tsit+ta bde ba ches: dbang bskur rigs lngas dbur brgyan bsam: brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje rkang lag mdzes pa'i gar: dga' ba'i glu dang rab tu sbyor: ngo mtshar chen po'i dam tshig gis: rjes su chags pa'i phyag bgyi'o: shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha na mā mi: mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' las byung ye shes sprin: lha yi me tog dmar ba'i mdangs: rdo rje rjes su chags pa'i spos: rin chen gzi ldan sgron ma che: sna tshogs dri zhim bsil ba'i chab: ro bcud nus ldan 'chi med bshos: 'jig rten dge ba'i dam tshig gis: mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: hūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai wi d+yā pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: drug las skyes sogs glu blangs shing : kun tu bzang po'i rol mo che: nam mkha' gang ba'i gar bcas pas: rdo rje rjes su chags par mdzod: hūm̐ shrī badz+ra rā ga gīrti nīrti shab+da pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lcags kyu lnga yi rgya mtsho che: sha chen lnga dang yang dag ldan: rdo rje gsum dang mnyam sbyor ba: bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi:

badz+ra a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mṛ tu sid+dhi ku ru ho: hūm̐: kha dog dri ro nus bcud ldan: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ btud pas bran: 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i: gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: shrī he ru ka rak+ta pi pā hoḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang : 'jig rten gsum po g.yo bar mdzad: dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i mchog chen stsol: don kun sgrub la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs nas 'od zer 'phros: bum pa'i lha yi sbyor mtshams zhugs: bde ba chen po'i rlabs g.yos pas: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags kyis mtshan pa'i ye shes bskul: de las rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun: yab yum mkha' dbyings sbubs su bskyil: char ltar babs nas bcud la thim: nus pa mchog tu bskyed par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: rtsa sngags ci rigs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī sho dha ne sho dha ne bi sho dha ne hūm̐ swā hā: ces las sbyor brgya rtsa tsam bzlas mthar mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dung zhal gyi mchod yon phul bas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yab yum dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces brjod/ rtsa dbang rkyang pa sogs stabs bder bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bskyed bzlas spyi mthun zhig byas pas chog go /gsum pa ni/ sta gon gyi chas rnams yol bas bsgrib/ rdzas bzhi/ nyer spyod lnga sogs 'du bya/ slob ma rnams la khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang*/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo/ srung 'khor gyis mtshams bcad/ sems bskyed gsal btab cing blo bcos pa'i thun mong gi chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir skabs su babs pa'i bshad bya ni/ rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu lam byed gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sdai chen po bzhir bzhugs pa las gong ma'i yang gong mar gyur pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su dbye ba'i nang tshan bde ba chen po'i myur lam gyis khyad par du byas pa ma rgyud yin cing*/

de la'ang rigs drug gi dbye ba can du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan 'dir ni rdo rje nyi ma rin 'byung gi rigs yin la/ snga 'gyur gyi rang rkang sgrub sde chen po brgyad du grags pa ltar na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub lugs lnga'i gtso bo yon tan bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa zab la 'dril zhing rang rkang tshugs pa/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gsang ba chen po dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bgyi ba la sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir sngon 'gro slob ma lhag par gnas pa bgyi ba'i skabs lags pas thog mar de nyid zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ ces pa tsam gyis mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer mi phyed pa la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo slob dpon ches: bdag la thugs brtses nyer dgongs nas: sngags kyi cho ga'i mthu chen pos: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btabs pas snod ldan tu rig nas gnang ba sbyin cing rjes su gdams pa yin pas 'di la gsan 'tshal/ e ma tshul chen sngags kyi mchog: dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam chen po: khyod la rab tu bstan par bya: spro ba skyed la gus pa yis: rang rgyud yongs su dag pa dang : rdo rje'i dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs: zhes gdams/ de la thog mar theg pa thun mong gi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa bzung dgos pas 'dun pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa sgo gsum gus pa chen pos byang chub ma thob kyi bar skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hūm̐: 'khor 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi che: dbyer med zung 'jug he ru ka: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhi rten byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la/ 'di ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can mtha' dag dpal bde ba chen po he ru ka'i go 'phang la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs shing rgyud smin par byas la grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la: dmigs med snying rjes kun bslangs te: bde chen sa la 'god pa'i phyir: khrag 'thung chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgom:

lan gsum/ dbang don gyi ye shes rgyud la gnas pa ni sdom pa dam tshig gi rten la rags las pas/ spyi'i dam tshig nyes spyod spong ba/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la bslab pa dang*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bde gshegs rigs lnga/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsum/ yan lag nyi shu rtsa lngas bsdus pa rnams dang*/ sgrub pa lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang legs par blangs nas tshul bzhin tu bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha: dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: bdag gis byang chub snying po'i bar: mtha' yas 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: gsang ba mchog gi sgor zhugs nas: nyes spyod cha dang bcas pa sdom: dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu sdud: sems can don ni mnyam med spyad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bzung zhing bsrung bar bgyi: lan gsum/ de nas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ skad cig gis khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi sku mdog ljang gu zhi ba'i nyams can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan cing zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin tu gsal ba la/ dbang yul dbyer med bde ba chen po'i rol mo nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos shig /me tog la sogs pas gnas so sor mchod pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai bi d+yā pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes pa'i bar 'gres sbyar/ so shing dang dor ba'i ra ba sogs rdzas bzhi 'du byas la/

dngos grub kyi ltas mtshan brtag pa'i slad du/ ngo bo rdo rje bdud rtsi khrag 'thung chen po la/ rnam pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i so shing du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: lan bdun nam gsum gyis so shing byin brlab/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing 'di nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du zung la dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas gsal bar bstan du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas ltos med du 'dor ba zhu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ha sa haṃ: zhes so shing ra bar 'dor du gzhug /de ltar dor ba'i so shing gi rtse mo shar du bstan na zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po'i phrin las rnams 'grub cing*/ mtshams su phran tshegs kyi dngos grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ slob dpon nam rang la bstan na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs so/ /dung zhal du dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i khyaur chu thogs la/ rin chen bdud rtsi ma mā ka'i rang bzhin can gyi khyor chu khong du btung bas mtshan ma'i rnam rtog ma lus pa dbyings su sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma mā ki sarba saṃ kalpa bi sho dha na swā hā: zhes dung chu sbyin/ dpung skud sngo nag mdud pa sum ldan/ hūm̐ gis sngags pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i mdud pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bc-ings pas sgo gsum la bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pas bcing*/ ku sha'i chun po che chung thogs la/ rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin dag byed rtswa mchog ku sha'i chun po chung ba sngas dang che ba stan gyi don tu zung zhig /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī a pra ti ha ta hūm̐ phaṭa:

ces lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtad/ do nub bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la mgo phyogs shing dad mos kyi 'dun pa rgyun chags dang bcas nyal bas bzang ngan mtshan ma gang mthong ma brjed par gyis la ngan na zlog pa'i gnyen po la 'bad par bya dgos so/ /zab mo'i lam las phyir mi ldog pa'i don du chos bshad cing spro ba skyed pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba las: rab tu dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg: de ring rnyed do skal bzang rnams: tshul chen 'di la gnas par gyis: des slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa rnams grub pa lags pas dge ba gzhan don rdzogs byang gi phyir du bsngo ba zhu/ zhes bsngo ba brjod la grol/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod/ nongs bshags bya/ bsdu ldangs dang shis brjod las byang ltar byas pas grub bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dkyil 'khor bsham bkod kyi rim pa/ dbang don sgrub mchod bya tshul/ dbang dngos ji ltar bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar sta gon byas pa'i gzhi la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su rkang gsum steng sku rnam rgyal bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings ljangs gus spras pa/ de'i khar gsung thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng du thugs me long sin+dhū ra bdal ba la chos 'byung grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil lte bar bam̐ yig gis mtshan pa bzhag /phyogs bzhi so so'am mdun du dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril lhan cig pa dang ming gi shog dril bcas/ de'i shar du rdo rje bdud rtsi'i khrus rdzas ldan pa'i khrus bum/ lhor thod snod du hūm̐ mdzad kyi bdug rdzas/ nub tu thod par ma da na'i phur ma chang dang sbyar ba dang*/ sin+dhū ra zhun mar bcas byang du thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsi ril bus gtams pa dar snas dril zhing dbu rgyan dar dpyang gis brgyan pa rnams legs par bkram/ lding khri bar pa lta bur dbus su bdud rtsi ril bu'i snying po can gyi mthong grol gter bum/

thos grol dung la bdud rtsi dang gi waṃ dri bzang sbyar bas byugs pa/ tshor grol ril bu dang spos sbyor dri zhim sbyar ba'i phye ma/ myong grol thod snod du ril bu blugs pa/ reg grol bdud rtsi dang ga bur dri bzang rnams sbyar ba'i phye ma dang thum bu btag chog /khyab grol klu sman bdud rtsi 'o ma rnams dngul snod du lhan cig sbyar ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ mthar skor du chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams spyi ltar bsham/ nye logs ji ltar bde bar mtha' rten chas/ dgang blugs/ dung*/ dril bu/ gzhung gi glegs bam rnams dang*/ sngon gtor/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul/ tshogs kyi yo byad chad mdo'i gtor ma rnams dang*/ slob dpon mdun du las bum sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshig bdun dang brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas las byang la 'jug /mchod pa'i skabs bdud rtsi la brgyud mchod sbyar zhing bstod pa'i bar song nas/ mdun dkyil gyi go sar dzab khang dbye/ bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu'i ting nge 'dzin sbyar la zhi khro'i bzlas pa ci 'grub cha snyoms par bzla/ bum pa sta gon song bas 'thus kyang spro na skabs 'dir skad cig gis bskyed pa dang bzlas dmigs spyi mtshungs kyis snying po gnyis bzla/ mchod bstod phul te bum lha 'od zhu byas pas rtsa ba'i dbang sgrub 'grub/ de nas yan lag rnams sgrub pa'i thog mar mchod kha gso zhing*/ hūm̐: gnas yul dur khrod rol pa'i zhing : sogs kyi mchod pa byin brlab bya ba thams cad la 'gres te/ thog mar khrus bum gong sta gon skabs ltar bdud rtsi 'khyil pas sgrub/ gnyis pa bdug spos bsgrub pa mchod brlab dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang*/ oṃ swā bhā ba bi shud+dho3haṃ: gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la: rang byung snod mchog yangs pa'i dbus: hūm̐ las rdo rje bdug pa'i tshogs:

kha dog dri dang nus par ldan: brtan g.yo'i stobs bcud kun 'dus pa: ye shes rang bzhin chen po'i steng : pad+ma nyi ma 'od 'bar dbus: hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du yis: gdug pa can rnams spa bkong zhing : sangs rgyas byang chub thugs dam bskul: srid zhi'i stobs bcud thams cad bkug: yongs gyur rdo rje hūm̐ kā ra: mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa: gtum zhing khro la bzhad pa'i nyams: phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis: bgegs 'dul phyag rgya brtan par 'ching : bar pas thabs shes mda' gzhu bkang : tha mas rang 'dra'i mā ma ki'i: rgyab nas 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad: dpa' gtum khro bo'i chags nyams rgyas: stag sham sbrul dang rus pas brgyan: zhabs zung lha chen pho mo'i steng : drag po'i me dpung dbus na 'gying : yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras: ye shes mkha' khyab sad par bsam: hūm̐: mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can: bcom ldan rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha: gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: hūm̐ mdzad khro bo chen por bzhengs: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dza: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ oṃ lha yi bdud rtsi dri ma med: ye shes lnga dang yang dag sbyor: byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis: rtog pa'i dri ma sbyang bar bya: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi tsit+ta a mṛ ta trām̐ hūm̐ oṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: bo dhi tsit+ta bde ba ches: dbang bskur rigs lngas dbur brgyan bsam: brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje rkang lag mdzes pa'i gar: dga' ba'i glu dang rab tu sbyor: ngo mtshar chen po'i dam tshig gis: rjes su chags pa'i phyag bgyi'o: shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha na mā mi: mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' las byung ye shes sprin: lha yi me tog dmar ba'i mdangs: rdo rje rjes su chags pa'i spos:

rin chen gzi ldan sgron ma che: sna tshogs dri zhim bsil ba'i chab: ro bcud nus ldan 'chi med bshos: 'jig rten dge ba'i dam tshig gis: mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: hūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai wi d+yā pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: drug las skyes sogs glu blangs shing : kun tu bzang po'i rol mo che: nam mkha' gang ba'i gar bcas pas: rdo rje rjes su chags par mdzod: hūm̐ shrī badz+ra rā ga gīrti nīrti shab+da pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lcags kyu lnga yi rgya mtsho che: sha chen lnga dang yang dag ldan: rdo rje gsum dang mnyam sbyor ba: bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi: badz+ra a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mṛ tu sid+dhi ku ru ho: hūm̐: kha dog dri ro nus bcud ldan: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ btud pas bran: 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i: gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: shrī he ru ka rak+ta pi pā hoḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng : hūm̐ yig 'bar ba chen po'i sngags: chos nyid rang sgras bskul ba las: lha mo rdo rje snying po ma: mthing ga pad+ma bdug spos bsnams: nam mkha' gang ba'i sprin spros pas: 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sbyangs: nad gdon bgegs tshogs rgyangs ring bskrad: ye shes rdo rje'i gur gyis bsrungs: tshur 'dus 'khor 'das nus stobs bcud: bdug pa'i sprin dang ro gcig par: spyan drangs rdzas la bstims pa yis: nus pa 'bum du bskyed par gyur: hūm̐ zhes brgya stong sogs bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba bigh+nān ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha u+u tsaṭ+ṭā ya u+u tsaṭ+ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: las sbyor ci 'grub mthar/

khro bo'i rgyal po 'od du zhu ste rdzas la thim pas hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i nus mthu'i stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i bdug par gyur/ ces dang rten snying lan gsum gyis rab gnas bya/ gsum pa ma da na sngar bsgrubs zin pa zhig med na dbang bskur thabs med cing 'di'i sgrub tshul cung mang bas longs skabs med tshe mdor bsdus tsam gyis chog la/ longs yod na rtsa ba'-i las byang bzlas pa'i bar btang*/ bzlas pa grub mthar/ oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kun: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud dbab tu gsol: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na lo ka rā sa yā na sa ma ya ā we sha ya a ā: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes bskul lha tshogs thams cad kun: rjes chags gzi byin rab 'bar bsam: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: a nu rā ga ya hoḥ a nu rā ga yā mi: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃḥ snyoms zhugs bde ba'i 'od zer gyis: srid zhi'i khams kun dbang med g.yos: dwangs bcud bde chen bdud rtsir bkug: zhal zhugs gsang ba'i pad+mor 'khyil: rjes chags chen por 'od zhu nas: ye shes bdud rtsi'i gzugs su gyur: de las slar yang skad cig gis: rin chen bdud rtsi mā ma kī: dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i 'od: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: rjes chags bzhad pa'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas nor bu'i lcags kyu yis: 'khor 'das kun gyi dwangs bcud 'gugs: g.yon pas rin chen ka pā lar: bde chen dngos grub rgya mtshor bskyil: dar dang rin chen rus pa dang : me tog dmar po'i rgyan gyis sgeg: zhabs zung pad nyi bam ro'i steng : bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i klong na bzhugs: thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i dbus: brtan g.yo srid zhi kun gyi srog: bam̐ yig dmar ser sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas thugs dam rgyud bskul te:

rang 'dra'i pho nya grangs med 'phros: 'jig rten brtan g.yo'i dwangs ma dang : bde gshegs sras bcas ye shes bcud: lcags kyus drangs shing thod par bskyil: zhal du bstim zhing bde bas myos: pad+mo'i sbubs nas char ltar babs: ma da na dang ro gcig 'dres: mthong thos myong tshor 'khor 'das srog: thams cad ma lus dbang byed pa'i: rā sa yā na'i mchog tu gyur: oṃ baṃ rat+na mā ma kī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha ma da na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: ces brgya rtsa tsam bzlas mthar/ lha mo nyid dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i gzugs su gyur/ ces brjod/ bzhi pa bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa la/ khrol bu phye ma lte gu gsum po sngar sgrub pa byas zin pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu la mi dgos pas/ skabs 'dir las byang ltar mchod pa brlab/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang*/ oṃ swā bhā ba bi shud+dho3haṃ: gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim dang : rin chen ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng : phyi ltar pad+ma bhañdza'i snod: yangs shing rgya che mtha' dbus bral: nang na ye shes gzhal med khang : rat+na dur khrod rdzas kyis spras: mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa: gsal dag 'od zer 'bar ba'i klong : ril bu yongs gyur skad cig gis: sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i steng : hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan: spro bsdus 'od kyi gong bu las: rdo rje bdud rtsi he ru ka: sku dang rtsa zhal nam mkha'i mdog: g.yas smug g.yon ser rgyab zhal dkar: rnam 'gyur mi bzad khro bo'i nyams: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum dbu skra smar smin 'bar: bdud rtsi'i glegs bam spyi bor 'chang : g.yas bzhi rdo rje rgyu ma'i phreng : tshangs pa'i mgo bo rtse gsum bsnams: g.yon bzhi kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag dang : srin po 'ching zhing rus phreng 'phyar: stag sham rin chen rus pa dang : rgyu ma me tog phreng bas brgyan: rang 'od mā kī khros mas 'khyud: ye shes me lce 'bar ba'i klong : g.yon brkyang dregs pa'i steng na 'gying : thugs kar bdud rtsi bde ba che: ljang ser rdo rje dril bu bsnams: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud pad zla'i steng : kha sbyor bde bas dgyes par bzhugs: yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems: hūm̐ yig brgyad kyi sprin spros pas: sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la: shar du ser mo gtsigs byed ma: lho ru dmar mo rab gtsigs ma: nub tu sngon mo gdol pa mo: byang du g.yung mo du ba'i mdog: shar lhor ser skya gtum mig ma: lho nub nag mo rigs can ma: nub byang ser mo drag shul can: byang shar nag mo 'jigs byed ma: kun kyang ral gri thod khrag 'dzin: khro mo'i nyams dang chas kyis brgyan: pad nyi dur khrod ro steng bzhengs: sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang :

lcags sgraug dril bu'i phyag rgya can: dkar dmar ser dang du ba'i mdog: g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'ching : rdo rje'i gtsug phud cod pan 'chang : 'od dmar phreng ba'i klong na rol: bar khyams mchod pa'i lha mo dang : dur khrod sha za'i tshogs kyis bskor: rdo rje pad+mar stsal ba las: bde chen thig le'i gzi byin 'bar: rol pa chen po'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' khyab ye shes sad par bsam: spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje bdud rtsi nye bar zhi ba mchog gi dbyings: 'jigs byed chen po he ru ka yi rnam par bzhengs: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro khrag 'thung mang po'i 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig dbang gis myur du dgongs shing gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūm̐ hūm̐: shrī he ru ka e h+ye hi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: dam tshig rdzas dang dbyer med pa'i: phyag rgya sgyu ma'i grong khyer du: ye shes rdo rje khrag 'thung lha: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho:dgyes par rol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang rol pa'i 'od zer gyis: dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar sad: byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas: rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas dbur brgyan bsam: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: brda phyag ni/ hoḥ 'jigs byed chen po mche ba gtsigs: bdud 'joms rgyu ma'i phreng bas brgyan: dam tshig sha chen khrag la gsol: he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal 'dud: shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la na mā mi: mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: nam mkha' las byung lha mo ni: drag shul 'jigs pa chen mo'i tshogs: dur khrod rdzas mchog dang sbyar te: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i gar gyis mchod: oṃ shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+mā sha na puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+yā shab+da pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba l̥ṃ ta kha hi: hūm̐: mchog tu zhi ba snying rje dam pa'i ye shes ni:

rgod gshe drag shul sngags kyi srog tu zhugs pa las: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung phyag rgya chen po'i skur snang ba: he ru ka dpal btsun mor bcas la phyag 'tshal 'dud: bshags pa ni/ oṃ: dpal ldan rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bdag: he ru ka dpal che ba'i mchog: rigs kyi yum dang rab sbyor ba'i: khrag 'thung lha tshogs bdag la dgongs: bdag cag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs kyang : nyon mongs dbang gis dam 'gal ba: bzod bzhes tshangs par mdzad nas kyang : dngos grub chen po stsal du gsol: oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya sid+dhi ku ru hoḥ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas: rnam par rtog pa dbyings su sbyangs: mnyam pa chen po'i ye shes kyis: bde chen bdud rtsi rgyas par mdzod: oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: bzlas pa bya ba ni gzungs thag blang la/ bdag nyid yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i: byang chub sems kyi 'od zer ni: khrag 'thung yab yum sbyor mtshams zhugs: rjes chags badz+ra ā ral+lis: thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' che'i: thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor hūm̐: rdo rje'i sngags kyis mtshan pa bskul: 'bar ba'i 'od dang hūm̐ gi sgras: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: dbang bcu'i ye shes thig ler thim: yi dam lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed: dngos grub thams cad dbang du gyur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig bskul: brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thogs med bkug: rigs drug 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dang : khams gsum dregs pa'i phung po bsgral: snyigs ma ye shes me yis bzhus: dwangs ma mi shigs rdo rje'i dbyig: rdzas dang dbyer med lha la thim: ye shes rig rtsal lhag par rgyas: 'khor 'das kun gyi srog tu bsam: oṃ shrī he ru ka dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: brgya rtsa tsam bzlas/ mtha' rgyas tshe'i las sbyor ni/

mdun bskyed thugs nas 'od zer 'phros: pad+ma gar dbang tshe dpag med: yab yum mnyam sbyor spyan drangs nas: thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das kyi: tshe yi bcud dang dwangs ma bsdus: zhal zhugs sku yi dbyibs las brgyud: sbyor mtshams nas babs bde ba'i bcud: lha dang sgrub rdzas dbyer med la: thim pas 'chi med gzi byin 'bar: 'gyur med rdo rje sems dpa' yi: tshe dang lang tsho ster bar bsam: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ā yu ṣe swā hā: cung zad bzla/ nor gyi las sbyor ni/ slar yang 'od kyi snang ba las: rin chen lha mo mā ma kī: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'phro 'du yis: srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dwangs bcud kun: 'od zer gzi brjid rnam par bsdus: lha dang sgrub rdzas dbyer med la: bstims pas 'dod don kun stsol ba'i: yid bzhin rin chen mchog tu bsam: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta shrī bā su sid+dhi swā hā: cung zad bzla/ mchog gi las sbyor ni/ slar yang 'od zer lcags kyu yis: rdo rje bdud rtsi sems dpa' che: kha sbyor bde ba'i phyag rgya dang : sngags dang phyag mtshan tshul du byon: lha dang sgrub rdzas dbyer med la: thim pas bde chen gzi byin 'phel: mthong thos myong bas grol ba yi: ye shes snying po rgyas par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa twa a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐ ho: cung zad bzla/ de nas bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag sngags srung ma'i phrin las skong ba rnams legs par grub nas/ las byang ltar tshogs byin brlabs nas tshogs mchod 'bul/ bdag 'jug blang grub na legs pas rtsa dbang dngos gzhi yan chad bya/ de ltar na sman dbang yang gal che bas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha wā ka ā yu ṣe sarba sid+dhi ā: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha tsit+ta dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na karma sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐:

zhes brjod la gnas gsum du dbang blang*/ de dag mi lcogs na spyi 'gro ltar rig pa'i me tog dor bas kyang 'thus/ gang ltar slob ma gzhug par gnang ba nod/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib bo/ /gsum pa dbang dngos la gsum/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos/ rtsa ba'i dbang bskur/ yan lag rjes su gnang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma rnams la sgo'i phyi rol du khrus bya zhing bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod/ bgegs gtor btang la bka' bsgo zhing hūm̐ mdzad kyi bdug pa dang yungs thun/ rol mo sogs kyis bgegs bskrad la srung 'khor bsgom/ gral du 'khod cing maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ de la 'dir skabs su babs pa'i gsang ba chen po 'di'i lo rgyus cung zad tsam brjod na/ 'og min rdo rje btsun mo'i gsang ba chen por bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor tshogs rab 'byams rgya mtsho la rtsa rgyud bdud rtsi dgyes pa/ bshad rgyud bdud rtsi rol pa/ bsdus rgyud bdud rtsi snying po/ cha mthun bdud rtsi yon tan rgyud sogs zab cing rgya che la bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa thams cad sprul pa'i sems dpas bsdus te ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gnyer du mdzad de bzhugs pa la/ sngon gyi dus su kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zab pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas dur khrod bsil ba tshal du sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud la brten nas rdo rje nyi ma sgrub pa'i tshe rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gzigs/ des lung bstan stsal ba ltar o rgyan dhu ma tha lar byon pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ glegs bam gnang ba la brten he ru ka bsgom pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ mal+la bar skal ldan gyi sprang po brgyad la dbang bskur bas dngos grub chen po re re thob/

de nas phyis zhig na slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang ba rjes su bzung ste/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag byin nas lha yul du 'gro don la gshegs/ bdud rtsi gsang bas kyang bsgoms pas mchog grub ste he ru ka dngos dang dbyer med du gyur/ phyis su slob dpon bha go rjes su bzung bas dngos grub brnyes shing bstan pa rgya cher spel/ des paṇ+ḍi ta dri med bzang po sogs la rgyud dang gdams pa gnang ba las brgyud de 'phags yul sogs su legs par dar ba slob dpon a bha ya'i rdo rje phreng bar bdud rtsi bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pas mtshon no/ /gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga dar skabs 'di'i smin grol gyi rgyun legs par byung bar mngon te gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis slob dpon khams pa jo sras las gnyags chen nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje bdud rtsi'i gdams skor gsan par gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las btus pa'i nyung ngu'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa gyi jo lo tsā zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba da lta rgyud 'bum na bzhugs pa 'di'i rgya dpe'ang sngar nas bzhugs par gsal la/ des na brgyud pa rin po che 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ dpal he ru ka dang dbyer ma mchis pa o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha ba de nyid kyis slob dpon chen po bdud rtsi gsang ba las rgyud dang man ngag rdzogs par gsan pa'i tshul bstan/ bal yul a su ra'i brag phug tu rigs ldan shākya de bī dang lhan cig sgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje bdud rtsi zhi ba dang khro bo'i gsang ba gsum dang dbyer med pa'i mchog grub cing rig ma'ang ma mā ki'i dngos grub thob/ rgyud don man ngag tu dril ba'i gzhung ting nge 'dzin bdun tu bsdus pa'ang mdzad/ bod du dam pa chos kyi sgron me sbar ba'i skabs su spyir skal ba dang ldan pa'i rje 'bangs mchog gi 'dus pa rnams la gsang chen bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zab cing rgya che ba du ma bskor/

bye brag 'phyos kyi gnyags lo tsā ba dzñā na ku mā ra la bdud rtsi yon tan gyi bka' babs pas de'i rgyud lung man ngag zab cing rgya che ba spyi dang khyad par gzhung 'di nyid kyang bsgyur du stsal/ slad nas yar mo lung bsam 'grub shel gyi brag phug tu gu ru rin po che yab yum rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ chos rgyal chen po yab sras dang*/ lo tsā ba mched kyi gtsos skal ldan 'dus pa rnams kyis rin po che'i me tog phul te gsol ba btab pas dgyes bzhin du ye shes kyi cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas smin grol rnams chig rdzogs su stsal/ de rnams kyis kyang nyams bzhes mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ dpe rgyud dang dam tshig gi rdzas rnams rdo rje'i lung bzhin pad+ma brtsegs pa'i phug par rgyas gdab/ gter srung ral gcig ma mo la gnyer du gtad pa phyis 'byung ba'i dus ni/ ji skad du/ pad+ma shel phug sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung : gter ston ra mo shel sman zhes bya 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra'i rnam 'phrul yar lung ra mo sman chu khar sku 'khrungs pa ra mo shel sman ye shes bzang po zhes bya ba grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pas dgun stod zhig la sman sgrub mdzad pa'i sman phud cha gcig gnas de'i sa dpal bzang ba zhig tu sbas pa las phyi lo nas sman shing gi sdong po khyad par can skyes/ de nas bzung dgun ka sman sgrub mdzad tshod tsam la me tog bkra ba'i ngo mtshar can phyis kyi bar yod par grags pas mtshon rnam thar phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab kyang sbas pa'i tshul gyis gso dpyad gtsor bton nas sems can 'bum phrag thar pa'i lam du bkod par mdzad pa de nyid kyis pad+ma shel gyi brag phug sogs nas zab gter mang po zhig spyan drangs par mdzad pa'i nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams skor 'di nyid rang nyid kyis thugs nyams su bzhes/

slar rdo rje'i lung don bzhin rang gnas su sbas par mdzad pa la/ deng sang gdul ba'i dus su babs pa'i dbang gis/ rgyal sras ye shes mchog grub rgyal po nyid gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum du bzhes pa'i phyi ma'ang rtse mor gyur pa/ gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ bka' bab chen po bdun gyi mnga' bdag pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa dgung grangs nga bdun me byi zla ba dang po'i yar tshes skabs kyi tho rangs shig tu sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi nyid zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gror rnam par 'phrul bas gdams pa 'di'i gter dpe tā la'i lo mar na ga ra dang brda yig 'dres mar bris pa phyag tu phul te lo rgyus rgyas par zhus/ de rjes o rgyan rin po che la gsol 'debs yang yang mdzad pas snron zla ba'i tshes bcu'i tho rengs dag pa'i snang bar pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang du gu ru rin po che 'khor dang bcas pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur cing gdams ngag gcig rdzogs su stsal/ las kyi rdo rje gnyags lo chen po'i zhal nas 'di nyid bdud rtsi yon tan gyi bka'i gtso bo yin cing da rung sman gyi rdzong 'phrang chen mo'i bka' babs yod tshul gyi lung bstan kyang mdzad/ de nas bzung ste gter shog tu gang bzhugs pa'i tshig don thams cad sgrib thogs med par thugs la lam mer chub pas chos skor yongs rdzogs mig 'phrul lta bu'i cho 'phrul chen po ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pas gtan la phab nas kho bo cag la skal ldan tu dbugs dbyung zhing dbang khrid gdams ngag thams cad bka' drin tu stsal ba'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal he ru ka rdo rje bdud rtsi/ slob dpon chen po bdud rtsi gsang ba/ rang byung pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro shākya de bī/ gsang sngags chu bo bzhi'i bka' babs gnyags chen dzñā na ku mā ra/ mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab sras/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/

sprul pa'i gter chen ra mo shel sman ye shes bzang po/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa/ des bdag la rab tshes chu rta rgyal zla ba'i dus tshes dge bar sgrub pa chen po'i tshul dang 'brel bar smin grol zab mo'i gdams ngag mtha' dag tshang sprugs su stsal ba ste/ de lta bu'i sngon med pa'i gsang ba chen po 'di la smin grol gy-i gdams skor gnyis su bzhugs pa las 'dir smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba yin/ de'ang bdud rtsi yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po la brten te rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i smin byed tshang bar bsgrub pa la gsum/ 'jug pa'i cho ga /dbang bskur dngos gzhi/ rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

zhes mtshams sbyar maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /sngon chad bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bcas pa mtshon pa'i phyir ras yug dmar pos gdong g.yogs par mos shig /oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha bā ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐/ zhes mig dar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten tu mchog gi me tog kha dog sna lnga pa'i chun po phyag tu thogs par mos shig /ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐: zhes cod pan sbyin/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la dad gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo slob dpon ches: bdag la thugs brtses nyer dgongs nas: sngags kyi cho ga'i mthu chen pos: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btabs pas snod ldan tu rig nas gnang ba sbyin cing rjes su gdams pa yin pas 'di la gsan 'tshal/ e ma tshul chen sngags kyi mchog: dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam chen po: khyod la rab tu bstan par bya: spro ba skyed la gus pa yis: rang rgyud yongs su dag pa dang : rdo rje'i dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs: zhes gdams/ de la thog mar theg pa thun mong gi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa bzung dgos pas 'dun pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa sgo gsum gus pa chen pos byang chub ma thob kyi bar skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi'i hūm̐: 'khor 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi che: dbyer med zung 'jug he ru ka: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhi rten byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la/

'di ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can mtha' dag dpal bde ba chen po he ru ka'i go 'phang la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs shing rgyud smin par byas la grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la: dmigs med snying rjes kun bslangs te: bde chen sa la 'god pa'i phyir: khrag 'thung chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgom: lan gsum/ dbang don gyi ye shes rgyud la gnas pa ni sdom pa dam tshig gi rten la rags las pas/ spyi'i dam tshig nyes spyod spong ba/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la bslab pa dang*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bde gshegs rigs lnga/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsum/ yan lag nyi shu rtsa lngas bsdus pa rnams dang*/ sgrub pa lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang legs par blangs nas tshul bzhin tu bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha: dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: bdag gis byang chub snying po'i bar: mtha' yas 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: gsang ba mchog gi sgor zhugs nas: nyes spyod cha dang bcas pa sdom: dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu sdud: sems can don ni mnyam med spyad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bzung zhing bsrung bar bgyi: lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa res mtshan par mos la bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya a ā: lan gsum/ rdo rje me tog bcas snying gar bzhag la/

sems bskyed par byas pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ : dam tshig ma 'dres pa dang nyams pa sogs snod ma yin pa la gsang bar gdams pa'i don 'di thugs la nges 'tshal/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod rdo rje bdud rtsi yi: dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya: gsang ba mchog gi spyod pa 'di: gzhan du smras na nyams par 'gyur: ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes gdams/ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces yol ba bsal/ las kyi rdo rje'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos shig /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bar mos la thal mo gnas gsum du bkod la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha maṇ+ḍal na mā miḥ slar yang shar gyi sgo nang du 'khod pa la dam tshig gi rdo rje'i chu nan sbyin pa yin te/ 'thungs shig rdo rje ma mā ki'i: ye shes bdud rtsi 'di 'thungs shig: dam tshig nyams na rab tu sreg: bsrung na tshe 'dir dngos grub thob: sa ma ya badz+ra ma mā ki a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha: zhes ma mā ka'i bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun la dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /de ltar bdud rtsi myang ba las: lus gang sgrib pa thams cad dag: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba yis: skad cig rdo rje bdud rtsi che: kha sbyor sku ru lam gyis gsal: sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan gyi steng : rin chen nyi ma de bzhin gshegs: rdo rje bdud rtsi sku mdog ljang : btso ma gser gyi mdangs 'od 'tsher: zhal gsum phyag drug zhi ba'i tshul: khro chags sgeg ldan spyan gsum g.yo: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar 'dzum 'od 'phro: rtsa phyag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud mnyam par sbyor: lhag ma 'khor lo ral gri g.yas:

zhags pa lcags kyu g.yon na bsnams: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pa yis: 'od zer 'bar 'phro'i klong na bzhugs: de yi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng : rdo rje bdud rtsi he ru ka: mthing nag khro tshul 'jigs pa'i nyams: rdo rje gdengs shing kha ṭ+wāṃ gsor: sbrul dang stag sham rus pas brgyan: rang 'od yum 'khyud me phung dbus: gar dgu'i rol pas rnam par 'gying : de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dkar dmar mthing ga'i mdog can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin tu gsal ba dang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gy-i gtso bo'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ chos kyi dbyings rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par bzhengs te nam mkha' gang ba tsam du byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlob par mos shig /'bebs pa'i rdzas bdug /dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rin chen nyi ma rtag pa'i dbyings: rgyun dang shugs kyi thugs rjer snang : bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa yis: ye shes sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston: dam tshig chen po'i dus lags na: sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob: bde chen bdud rtsi'i dbang mchog skur: rnal 'byor mthu dang ldan pa yis: dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐: e ā ral+li dzñā na ā we sha ya a āḥ ces sngags drag tu brjod la byin dbab/ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par byas par mos shig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag /me tog 'dor gzhi tshom bu sogs bkod la/ de nas rigs brtag pa'i slad du/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mngon sum du gsal ba la khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod la me tog 'dor ba zhu/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: zhes 'dor du gzhug la dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi rigs nges pa bya/ me tog lhag pa'i lha gang la phog pa de nyid kyis slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor dbang rtags cod pan gyi tshul du bcings par mos shig /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes cod pan mgor bzhag /ma rig pa'i sgrib pa mig dar dang lhan cig tu gsal bar mos shig /oṃ dzñā na badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: ces mig thur gyis bsal/ de ltar rnam dag ye shes kyi mig gsar du thob pas dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mjal bar gyur par mos shig /phyag shing gis mtshon la/ ltos shig skal ldan rigs kyi bu: phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di la ltos: khyod ni sgrib dag ye shes mthong : rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rigs su skyes: sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis: dngos grub dam pa 'thob par 'gyur: de'ang 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du phyi rin po che las grub cing nang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi sku mdog ljang ser zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum ma mā ki la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan cing zhabs skyil krung phyed pas 'char ka'i 'od klong na bzhugs pa/ de rgyab pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du zhi ba ma dkar mo/ lhor zhi gdong ma ser mo/ nub tu zla can ma dmar mo/ byang du ri bong can ma ljang mo/ shar lhor zla dkyil ma sngon mo/ lho nub tu zla mdzes ma ljang mo/

nub byang du yid 'ong ma sngo bsang*/ byang shar du sim byed sngon mo ste brgyad ka'ang rdor dril bsnams shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan ldan rang 'od kyi klong na phyed skyil gyis rol pa/ sgo bzhir sgo ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag rgya g.yon dril bu 'khrol zhing khro 'dzum dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ pad zla'i steng na gar thabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje bdud rtsi he ru ka yum dang bcas pa/ bar mtshams mchod pa'i lha mo du mas gang ba rnams mngon sum bzhin tu mjal bar mos la dad gus spro ba rgya chen po skyed cig /de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor phyi nang du 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams grub pa lags/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba la/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ ngo sprod don gyi dbang bskur bzhi rim par 'byung ba las/ dang po zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ji ltar rdo rje bdud rtsi ches: rigs kyi sras rnams dbang bskur ltar: bdag kyang yongs su bzung ba'i phyir: smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de'ang bum pa'i dbang la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis su 'byung ba'i dang po rig pa'i dbang lnga rim par bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba spyi bo nas blugs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang bskur thob par mos shig /rnam bum mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ye shes ni: byang chub sems kyi rgyun dang sbyar: dag pa'i de nyid bde ba ches: sangs rgyas thugs su dbang bskur ro:

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha su ra tā s+t+waṃ a haṃ: zhes bum chu sbyin/ dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin chen mā ki'i ye shes kyi ngo bo cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbu la brgyan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dbang bskur thob par mos shig /dbu rgyan bcings la/ trām̐: rin chen mā ki'i ye shes ni: bde gshegs mnga' bdag cod pan che: dar dpyangs dag dang rab ldan pas: sangs rgyas yon tan dbang bskur ro: oṃ rat+na ma mā ki badz+ra mu ku ṭa pa ṭa laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje phyag g.yas su gtad pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang bskur thob par mos shig /rdo rje lag g.yas pas gsor du gzhug la/ hrīḥ hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i ye shes ni: thabs kyi rdo rje bde ba che: rab tu gsor zhing bskyod pa yis: sangs rgyas gsung gi dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐: dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dril bu phyag g.yon tu byin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbang bskur thob par mos shig /dril bu lag g.yon pas dkrol du gzhug la/ hāḥ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ye shes ni: shes rab dril bu'i sgra chen pos: 'khor 'das thams cad sad mdzad pas: sangs rgyas phrin las dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa ma ya ghāṇ+ḍe a ā: dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bdud rtsi khrag 'thung chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i gsang mtshan btags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dbang bskur thob par mos shig /oṃ: dpal ldan khrag 'thung ye shes ni: rdo rje ming dang gnyis su med: srid pa kun tu rab grags pas: sangs rgyas sku yi dbang bskur ro: oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ:

me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang mtshan so sor gtags la ming gi shog dril de ltar sbyin/ de rnams kyis rig pa'i dbang lnga thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes rnam pa lnga mngon tu byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i bum pa gnas gsum du bzhag pas rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i gsang ba gsum dang dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang mchog tu mnga' gsol bar mos shig /thod pa'i bdud rtsi gnas gsum du bzhag la/ oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: thugs gsung sku ru dbang bskur bas: deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis: dkyil 'khor bdag po'i rjes su spyod: oṃ sarba thā ga ta shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūṃ āḥ.oṃ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang stong chu zla lta bu'i lha'i 'khor lo sgom pa dang mi 'bral bar tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad la lha sku phyag rgya'i gzer gyis theb par gyis shig /rjes 'brel du bzlas pa'i lung blang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje bdud rtsi yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bdud rtsi khrag 'thung yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūm̐ ljang ser/ de'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros/ zhal nas zhal du brgyud de khyed rang lhar gsal ba'i zhal nas thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i zhal du zhugs/ de'i thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u'i dbus kyi sa bon hūm̐ ljang ser gyi mtha' bskor du 'khod/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang*/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/
oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi swā hā:

lan gsum/ slar ye shes sems dpa'i sku las phyag rgya sngags phran phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa nam mkha' gang ba 'phros/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mchod/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi rtog sgrib sbyangs/ thams cad lha sngags chos sku dag pa rab 'byams su gyur par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo swā hā: lan gsum /slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba re 'bul ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje'i gsang sngags stsal lags kyi: ye shes brtan par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ me tog de nyid sngags phreng du byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bcing bar mos shig /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i gsang ba'i sngags: 'di la rab tu stsal lags kyi: rtag tu byin gyis brlabs nas kyang : dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol: badz+ra man+t+ra dzñā na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes me tog mgor bzhag /deng phyin chad grags stong sgra brnyan lta bu'i bzlas brjod chu bo'i rgyun bzhin tu brtson cing phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad la rdo rje'i sngags kyi gzer gyis thebs par gyis shig /don dam de kho na nyid kyi dgongs pa zab mo ngo sprod pa'i tshig 'di la gsan cing don thugs la nges par mdzod cig /'di ltar chos rnams thams cad kun: rang gi sems tsam nyid du brtag: sems tsam rnam par shes pa ste: rnam shes gdod nas skye ba med: skye med rang bzhin lhar shar ba: gzugs ni dpal ldan khrag 'thung ste: tshor ba rin chen mā ma kī: 'du shes badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra: 'du byed rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil: rnam shes bdud rtsi bde ba che: thams cad dbyer med 'od gsal las: lha dang sngags ni cir yang 'char: bu khyod de ltar rab rtogs pas: dbang por gang dang gang snang ba: de de lha sngags ye shes kyi: rdo rje bdud rtsir rtag tu ltos: ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ deng phyin chad rig stong phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rol pa las ma g.yos par dran rtog thams cad la 'phro 'du ting nge 'dzin dang chos nyid dgongs pa'i gzer gyis thebs par gyis shig

/ces gdams/ dbang gi dag pa brjod pa ni/ bum pa'i dbang thob lus sgrib dag: sku yi phyag rgya bsgrub la dbang : sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan gyur: de ltar bum pa'i dbang gis lus rtsa khams ye shes su smin pa de nyid grol byed lam rim nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag kyang gter gzhung rdo rje'i gsung las 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ sku yi phyag rgya che mchog ni: ji ltar me long dag pa la: phyi rol gzugs brnyan 'dus pa ltar: snang tsam dngos po sems su brtag: rang gi lus dang dbyer med shes: de las rlung dang sems tshogs pa: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal: de yi dbus na gnas pa'i rtsa: mi gsal gsal ba chen po ste: dwangs pa shel gyi sbu gu'i gzugs: dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan pa'i: a ba dhū ti'i dbus su ni: sran ma tsa na ka yi dbyibs: thig le phra mo snying gar bsgom: g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab kyi: rtsa gnyis yang dag 'khyud ldan pa: 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa bsam: rlung ni dal bus dbyung ba'i tshe: snying ga'i 'od kyis snod bcud khyab: ma dag bsregs shing dag pa'i bcud: bzhu btul rngub pa'i sbyor bas drang : mi shigs thig ler ro gcig pa'i: gzi brjid chen po'i 'od gsal las: mkha' khyab dkyil 'khor spro dang bsdu: de ltar yang yang goms pa yis: snang ba sgyu ma'i lha skur shar: sku yi rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'grub: zhes dal bus bklag /ces gdams par mdzad de/ de'ang thog mar bsam gtan gyi snod rung du byed pa'i sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas rgyud sbyangs/ khyad par bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa la drod tshad thob par byas nas/ man ngag rdzogs pa'i rim pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i thog mar sku rdo rje phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i tshul zab la 'dril bar bstan pa'i don de nyams su len par mdzad 'tshal lo/

/gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gi slad du/ bla ma yab yum dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po dang rin chen ma mā kī mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rnams dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang sems kyi rgyun dang 'dres pa de nyid mkha' gsang nas babs te thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig sbyor ba khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu byin par mos shig /thod pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman mngar gsum dang sbyar ba byin la/ hoḥ mu tig ltar dkar bde ba che: stong nyid ye shes dmar 'od 'phro: dbyer med byang chub sems chen pos: sangs rgyas sras su dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ de ltar byin pa'i bdud rtsi de nyid rtog pa med pa'i sems kyis rol la sngags 'di brjod par zhu/ a ho ma hā su kha: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtogs tshogs dbyings su nub/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig /lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis snam sbyar mnab/ skyabs sbyin phyag rgya sogs spyi ltar byas la/ slob dpon nyid sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i skur gnas 'gyur bas khyed rang rnams byang chub chen por lung bstan stsol bar mos shig /oṃ: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: deng khyod byang chub lung ston te: rdo rje bdud rtsi dpal zhes pa'i: mtshan gyis sa gsum dge bar 'gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a mri ta ma hā su kha nā ma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes lung bstan la dag brjod ni/ gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag sgrib dag: gsung gi phyag rgya bsgom la dbang : longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan gyur: de ltar gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag rlung ye shes su smin pa de nyid grol byed lam rim nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag kyang 'di lta ste/

gsung gi phyag rgya che mchog ni: ji ltar dbugs kyi sbyor gcig las: sna tshogs gling bu'i skad 'byung ltar: grags tsam dngos po rlung du brtag: rang sngags nā da dbyer mi shes: de las snyigs ma'i rlung bsal te: dwangs ma sbyor bzhis rab tu gzung : bum pa lta bur dgang ba yis: phyi nang rgyu ba 'gags pa dang : lus sems bde ba sim pa na: lte ba'i gtum mo sbar ba las: glog gi zer ma lta bu'i 'od: shin tu tsha zhing g.yo ba can: 'khor lo'i gnas bzhir thogs med zhugs: snyigs ma'i khams rnams rang bzhin sbyang : dwangs ma 'phel nas bde ba rgyas: mthar gyis haṃ yig thig le'i gzugs: bde chen bskul bas rab 'dzag ste: dga' mchog khyad par lhan skyes kyi: bdud rtsi 'phel bas gnas rnams gang : slar yang ches cher 'bar 'dzag gis: drod dang bde ba yang yang spel: sad pa bde chen sgyu ma'i lha: gnyid log 'od gsal rtog pa med: rmi lam bde rlung lha yi sku: snyoms 'jug bde ba'i rang ngo bskyang : de ltar rtag tu sbyor ldan pas: drod dang bde ba la brten nas: gsal la 'dzin med ye shes kyis: gsung gi bdud rtsi 'chi med 'grub: ces gsungs pa'i don la nyams len gyi brtson pa bskyed 'tshal/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ rigs dang ldan cing mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs ma mdun tu 'khod pa la/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor rin chen ma mā ki ru gsal ba de la thim/ de nyid khyed rang rnams la phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi don tu byin par mos shig /sin+dhū ra'i me long lag par gtad la/ ho: khyod ni rdo rje bdud rtsi ste: shes rab ma mā ki dang sbyor: 'dod chags chen po'i rol pa yis: dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed par gyis: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma mā ki ma hā su kha dzñā na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi/ gtad pa'i rig ma ma mā ki /mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+ma/

sems can thams cad kyi phyir bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don tu gnyer ba'i 'dun pa ste 'du shes gsum mnyam par ldan pas 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal bskul te snyoms par zhugs pas yas bab rgyu dang mas brten 'bras bu'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes mngon tu gyur par mos shig /rdau rje'i brtul zhugs grub pas lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin cing 'bras bu la som nyi med par dbugs dbyung ba ni/ skal bzang 'dod la spyod pa khyod: lam la the tshom med sbyar ba'i: 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsang ba mchog la zhugs pa yin: ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho: dag pa brjod pa ni/ gsum pa'i dbang thob yid sgrib dag: thugs kyi phyag rgya bsgom la dbang : chos sku thob pa'i skal ldan gyur: de ltar sher ye'i dbang gis yid thig le bde stong du smin pa de nyid grol byed lam rim nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag kyang 'di lta ste/ thugs kyi phyag rgya che mchog ni: ji ltar sgyu ma'i sngags kyis su: sna tshogs gzugs brnyan mthong ba ltar: khams gsum sems tsam de nyid kyang : bde ba che las yang dang snang : bde de phyag rgya'i pad+mar gnas: bcud dgug pas ni gsal bar 'gyur: ma dang sring mo bu mo dang : snag gi gnyen mtshams bran mo ste: rigs can rnam pa lngar yang shes: ma ni pad+ma can mchog ste: sring mo dung can ma ru grags: bu mo ri dwags can ma ste: snag gi gnyen mtshams glang po'i sna: bran mo ri mo can du gsungs: gang yang thabs kyis dbang byas te: thun mong khyad par lam la gzhug: ting 'dzin las su rung ba na: rdo rje bdud rtsi mā ma kī'i: nga rgyal brtan pos rtsa rlung sbyang : sha lnga bdud rtsi rab bza' zhing : khams kyi dwangs ma lhag par spel: 'o byed pas ni dga' byas la: brtan por 'khyud pas don la bskul: chags pa'i glu yi sil snyan sbyor: bung ba pad+mar rtse tshul gyis:

rdo rje bdud rtsi ā ral+li'i: dal bus bsrubs shing ngal yang bso: de tshe mkha' gsang e dang wam̐: pad+ma badz+ra yang dag shes: sems can don la rjes chags pas: chags pa'i me chen rab tu sbar: khams g.yos pa na sems bzung ste: gnas bzhir dga' ba'i don la blta: rdo rje nor bu'i rtser son par: bdud rtsi dbab bskyil mnyam par bzhag: reg bya rmad byung bde ba cher: rtog tshogs rags pa thim gyur nas: rlung gi gzhu la ting 'dzin mda': hūm̐ gdangs rgyu dang 'khrul 'khor gyis: chu skyes sbubs nas bdud rtsi bzhin: skad cig gyen la drangs shing dgram: bde chen haṃ dang mi phyed pas: sum cu rtsa gnyis dga' ba ni: de kho nyid la yang dag rdzogs: rtog tshogs phra ba'ang thim gyur pas: sangs rgyas ye shes mtshon byed pa: lhan cig skyes pa chen po 'char: snyigs ma dwangs mas phug pa'i lus: 'ja' tshon lta bur rang shar nas: bde ba che dang mi phyed pa'i: thugs kyi rdau rje rtag pa 'grub: ces pa'i don rnams la rtse gcig tu nyams su len par zhu/ bzhi pa don dam de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ khyed rang lus gnad bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas/ sngar gsum pa'i skabs nyams su myong ba de nyid ye shes kyi dper mtshon pa yin pas nyams myong de slar yang dran pas/ mtshon bya rang gnas gdod ma'i zung 'jug shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gshis lugs de kho na nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig /a: bde ba'i ye shes rtog pa ste: rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa nyid: rdo rje bdud rtsi de kho na: bsam mi khyab par rab tu sgoms: oṃ shrī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha shū n+ya tā āt+ma ko3haṃ: zhes cung zad 'jog /des 'khor 'das bsal bzhag med pa'i dgongs pa nam mkha' lta bu mngon tu gyur te 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs pas byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'grub par gzengs bstod pa yin te/ e ma don gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: zhugs pa dang ni rab rtogs pas:

srid dang zhi ba las 'das pa'i: ye shes mchog tu grub pa'o: dzñā na sa ma ya a la la ho: dag brjod ni/ bzhi pa'i dbang thob shes sgrib dag: ye shes phyag rgya bsgom la dbang : ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ldan gyur: de ltar bzhi pa'i dbang gis sgo gsum rdo rje'i ye shes su smin pa de nyid grol byed lam rim nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag kyang 'di lta ste/ ye shes phyag rgya che mchog ni: ji ltar snod bcud thams cad kun: nam mkha'i dbyings su ro gcig bzhin: 'khor dang 'das pa'i chos rnams kun: rig pa dri med gcig pur 'dus: de ni rtog ge'i gnas min te: nyan thos rang rgyal lam las 'das: byang chub sems dpa'i yid dpyod min: sems dpa' che mchog sngags kyi sgo: rdo rje'i brtul zhugs spyod pa rnams: bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas: skad cig nyid la tshul 'di mthong : de ni sems can kun gyi srog: nam du'ang gzhig pa med pa ste: rgyun mi chad pas rtag pa nyid: bsam gyis mi khyab thog ma med: dbang po rnams las yang dag 'das: ngo bo nyid kyis yod min zhing : mtshan nyid tsam du med pa'ang min: sna tshogs rnam par 'byung 'gyur zhing : byung ba'i dus nas skye ba med: ma skyes 'gag med 'gyur ba bcas: ji lta bur ni bsam par bya: kun tu rtogs pas ma mthong ba: de nyid mthong ba chen po ni: 'phags pa'i bden par mngon shes pa: lam gyi sa mtshams tsam du dbye: 'di ltar phung po khams skye mched: sna tshogs brtan dang g.yo ba sogs: khams gsum po ni thams cad kun: sems tsam nyid du rnam par brtag: sems tsam rnam par shes pa ste: de yi chos nyid mtha' las 'das: shes dang shes bya ro gcig par: gang tshe rnal 'byor mngon sum mthong : de tshe chos rnams ro gcig pa: bde ba'i babs kyis gsal byas te: yang dang yang du mnyam gzhag na: sgrib pa thams cad spang bar 'gyur: gang zhig yid ni mi g.yo zhing : rlung yang rang bab ngang du 'ching :

bya rtsol bral ba'i de kho na: chu bo rgyud kyi ting 'dzin no: mnyam par bzhag pa 'od gsal te: ldang tshe bde chen zung du 'jug: 'pho ba mtha' dag rab bcom pa'i: ye shes rdo rje mthar thug 'grub: ces gsungs pa'i don la nyams len gyi snying por dril bar mdzod cig /de ltar rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zab mo la brtson pa'i yon tan kyang*/ gzhung las/ de lta bu yi zab mo'i lam: zla drug lo gsum bcu gnyis nas: goms pa brtan po'i sbyor ba yis: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sku thob 'gyur: rtsa rlung thig le sems dang bcas: g.yo ba mtha' dag rab zhi ba'i: nam mkha' lta bu'i ting 'dzin las: 'jug dang ldang bar byar med kyang : 'gyur med bde ba snying rje'i stobs: stong pa'i srog tu rdzogs pa las: mkha' khyab ye shes sgyu ma yis: 'khor ba ji srid gzhan don 'byung : ces gsungs pa ltar nges pa lags pas thugs la gcag par zhu/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur dngos gzhi grub pa lags/ gsum pa rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la/ las so sor sgrub pa dang thun mong du bya ba gnyis las dang po phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/

rdo rje bdud rtsi'i khrus dbang dang*/ rdo rje hūm̐ gi bdug rdzas kyi dbang*/ ma mā ki'i bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs gsum gyi yig cha zur du yod pa gzigs mchan/ gzhung las/ nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i khrus nas dbyung : zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar zhi ba rdo rje bdud rtsi'i khrus dbang gi slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas/ shis brjod phan yon bstan pa'i bar dang*/ gnyis pa/ bar chad nyon mongs bskrad pa'i phyir: rdo rje hūm̐ gi bdug pa sbyar: zhes gsungasapa'i= rdo rje hūm̐ gi bdug rdzas kyis bar gcod nyon mongs skrod pa drag po'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i maṇ+ḍal nas/ shis brjod phan yon gyi bar dang*/ gsum pa gzhung las/ snang sems dbang du sgyur ba'i phyir: ma mā ki yi bdud rtsi sbyin: ces 'byung bas dbang byed mā ki'i rdzas kyi byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul ba nas/ gdams ngag shis brjod bar zur gsal ltar 'dir sbyar/ bzhi pa ni gzhung las/ ye shes mchog tu rgyas pa'i phyir: bdud rtsi chen po'i dbang yang bskur: ces gsungs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi ye shes rgyas par byed pa yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ma mā ki dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: bde chen bdud rtsi'i slob dpon gyis: 'chi med rtag pa'i ye shes kyi: dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs gsum/ sgrub pa'i ma da na bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba byin la/ oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi ma mā ki'i: dngos grub lhag pa'i dam rdzas mchog: deng 'dir khyod la sbyin pa yis: rtog pa'i dri ma kun dag shog: oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma mā ki ma da na a mṛ ta hūm̐ hoḥ

bdud rtsis lus gang bde bas myos: spang blang rtog pa'i dri ma dag: dngos grub ye shes mchog gi snod: rin chen bdud rtsi ma mā ki: dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i 'od: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: rjes chags bzhad pa'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas nor bu'i lcags kyu yis: 'khor 'das kun gyi dwangs bcud 'gugs: g.yon pas rin chen ka pā lar: bde chen dngos grub rgya mtshor bskyil: dar dang rin chen rus pa dang : me tog dmar po'i rgyan gyis sgeg: zhabs zung pad nyi bam ro'i steng : bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i klong na bzhugs: de ltar khyed rang yum mchog ma mā ki'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du bam̐ dmar ser gsal ba dang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gy-i gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad khyab/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskul/ thams cad kyang dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i he ru ka yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par bzhengs nas rgya mtsho la char chen po babs pa ltar khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la sib sib thim par mos shig /'bebs rdzas dang rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ hūm̐: rdo rje bdud rtsi nye bar zhi ba mchog gi dbyings: 'jigs byed chen po he ru ka yi rnam par bzhengs: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro khrag 'thung mang po'i 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig dbang gis myur du dgongs shing gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūm̐ hūm̐: shrī he ru ka e h+ye hi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ: ces brjod la byin dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan/ ril bu'i pho brang thogs la/ bhañdza'i snod ye shes kyi gzhal med khang gi nang du ril bu rdo rje bdud rtsi he ru ka yab yum 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlab pas/

sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sku'i phyag rgya mngon tu gyur par mos shig /oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: ye shes sku yi dbang bskur bas: lus kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku thob shog: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na kā ya a bhi ṣañtsa oṃ: ril bu'i snod mgrin par bzhag ma da na dang sbyar ba myang du gzhug la/ lha 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i gzugs su gyur pas mgrin par byin gyis brlabs shing bdud rtsi myang bas ngag rlung g.yo rtsol gyi sgrib pa dag /mi shigs g.yung drung lta bu'i srog thob par mos shig āḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: bde chen gsung gi dbang bskur bas: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: g.yung drung lta bu'i srog thob shog: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha wā ka ā yu+u ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ril bu byin la/ lha dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i ril bu lce la bzhag pa snying dbus su thim pas gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog gi sgrib pa dag /bde ba chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes mngon tu byas par mos shig hūm̐: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: 'od gsal thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: bde chen ye shes 'grub par shog: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha tsit+ta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ril bu sin+dhū ra dang bsres pa'i ldai gus snying khar thig le bkod la/ dam rdzas ril bu'i thig le snying gar bkod pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ 'phros te thim/ shin tu rnam par dag pa don gyi lhan skyes mkha' khyab kyi dgongs pa mngon tu gyur par mos shig /āḥ rdo rje spros bral stong pa nyid: bdud rtsi bde chen dri ma med: zung 'jug shin tu rnam par dag: mkha' khyab dgongs pa mngon gyur shog: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

des bdud rtsi rtsa ba'i dbang bskur legs par grub nas/ 'gro don las sbyor rnam drug gi rjes gnang rim par sbyin pa la/ bdud rtsi ril bus bcud du bltams pa'i gter bum bstan cing gtad pas mthong bas grol ba'i phrin las la mnga' brnyes par mos shig /dbang rdzas rnams bsgrag tshig dang mthun par so sor gtad pa sogs byas la/ oṃ: bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dngos: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' dbyings su: bde chen bdud rtsi'i gter sbas pas: dngos grub ye shes rgyas gyur cig: oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni dhū tu badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: bdud rtsis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dung dkar rna bar bsgrags pas thos pas grol ba'i phrin las la dbang thob par mos shig oṃ: bkra shis chos kyi sgra chen ldan: rdo rje snyems ma'i ye shes dang : bde chen bdud rtsi mnyam sbyor bas: sangs rgyas gsung dang dbyer med shog: oṃ hūm̐ sa twa badz+rī ṇī shap+da badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūm̐ hūm̐: bdud rtsi spos dang sbyar ba snar bdug pas tshor bas grol ba'i phrin las la byang chub par mos shig: oṃ: bkra shis zag med ye shes dri: dam tshig sgrol ma'i shugs 'chang ba: bde chen rdo rje bdud rtsi yi: ye shes 'bebs pa nyid gyur cig: oṃ tāṃ ta ra badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha dzñā na ā we sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐: myong grol gyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ rang nyid rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ljags: pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa'i: ze'u 'brur āḥyig dmar pos mtshan: mthe bong pad+ma gar dbang dang : srin lag gos dkar yum du gsal: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin: ljags kyi āḥl thim pa yis: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: ye shes chu rgyun rab tu 'phel: mgrin pa nas brgyud lus kun gang : nad gdon sdig sgrib rnam rtog sbyangs: bde chen ye shes mchog tu rgyas:

dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: oṃ: bkra shis 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud: gos dkar yum gyi pad+ma las: rdo rje'i ljags kyi dbang bskur bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis brtan par shog: oṃ bām̐ paṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes ril bu myang du gzhug /bdud rtsi dri dang sbyar ba lus la byugs pa dang ril bu mgul du btags pas reg pas grol ba'i phrin las kyi rtsal rdzogs par mos shig /oṃ: bkra shis yid bzhin rin chen bcud: reg bya ma mā ki dang sbyar: gang gis 'chang dang reg pa kun: bde chen ye shes rgyas par shog: oṃ bam̐ ma mā ki badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: bdud rtsi klu sman dang sbyar ba gtad pas chu bo dbyings khyab kyi 'gro don mtha' ru phyin par mos shig oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs dang : rin chen mā ki'i bden stobs kyis: srid pa'i rlan gyis khyab tshad kun: bde chen ye shes lhun grub shog: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha sarba ar+tha sid+dhi sid+dhi swā hā: de lta bu'i mchog gi las sbyor dam rdzas bdud rtsi chen po 'di nyid kyi ngo bo'i yon tan dang tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i phan yon/ grol ba drug gis las la sbyor ba'i dgos pa rnams gter gzhung rdo rje'i gsung las 'di skad du/ de ltar mchog gi las sbyor ni: dngos grub ye shes rgyas pa'i thabs: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas che'i: yon tan zab mo'i rgyud sde las: rdo rje na ra'i bza' ba yis: lus sems sdom ldan zhe sdang dang : des bskyed nad gdon bgegs rigs sel: rdo rje gsum mchog mngon du byed: rdo rje ga bi'i bza' ba yis: lus sems brtan cing nga rgyal dang : des bskyed nad gdon bgegs rigs sel: rtag pa dam pa'i mchog thob 'gyur: rdo rje gho ra'i bza' ba yis: blo gsal yid gzhungs 'dod chags dang :

des bskyed nad gdon bgegs rigs sel: kun mkhyen nyid kyang thob par 'gyur: rdo rje shwa na'i bza' ba yis: bying rmugs zhi zhing gti mug dang : des bskyed nad gdon bgegs rigs sel: rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs su 'gyur: rdo rje ha sti'i bza' ba yis: kun gyi yid 'phrog phrag dog dang : des bskyed nad gdon bgegs rigs sel: stobs bcu dag kyang thob par 'gyur: bdud rtsi mu tra'i dam tshig gis: nad kun sel zhing dbyangs snyan byed: 'pho ba'i nad dang rims rnams srung : mi bskyod rdo rje'i ye shes thob: bdud rtsi'i biṣ+ṭhī dam tshig gis: mdog bzang gzi brjid chen por byed: sbyar dang gyur pa'i dug kun 'joms: rdo rje rtag pa'i tshe thob 'gyur: bdud rtsi'i shu kra'i dam tshig gis: gzungs dran mngon shes sna tshogs 'char: nus par ldan zhing 'dod rgu 'grub: rdo rje stobs kyi mchog thob 'gyur: bdud rtsi rak+ta'i dam tshig gis: rgas pa med pa'i dbang po gsal: 'byung bzhir dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul stobs: rdo rje dbang bcu'i mchog thob 'gyur: bdud rtsi go ro tsa na yis: 'dod pa'i bde ba rab tu 'phel: las rnams thogs med mthu dang ldan: rdo rje sems dpa'i lus thob 'gyur: de rnams thams cad rab sbyar bas: dug lnga sel zhing nad lnga zhi: gdon lnga 'joms shing stobs lnga thob: sku lnga ye shes lnga 'grub 'gyur: rnam mang sman dang sbyar ba yis: 'du ba'i nad rnams 'byang ba dang : tshe ring rgas sra dbang po gsal: rtsa rlung thig le las rung byed: khyad par mchog tu byin brlabs pas: phyi nang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du: yul phyogs dge zhing bkra shis 'phel: sgrub gnas byin chags ye shes skye: 'ja' tshon lus dang g.yung drung srog: 'od gsal dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i: go 'phang dka' ba med par thob: ril bu gang gis mthong ba'am: dri tshor mgul du 'chang ba dang :

cung zad myang ba thams cad kyang : lcags las gser 'gyur rtsis btab bzhin: bde ba chen pos byin brlabs pas: 'khor ba ngan song las grol zhing : mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba dang : byang chub mchog gi rigs su skye: lha dang ril bu dbyer med pa: mthong bas bum dbang rtogs pa thob: myangs pas gsang ba'i ye shes dang : byang sems 'phel bas dga' bzhi skye: de nyid ngang du mnyam bzhag pas: snod bcud phung khams skye mched kun: don gyi bdud rtsir rnam dag pa'i: bzhi pa'i lam mchog tshe 'dir 'grub: ces gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos pa phan yon mtha' yas pa dang ldan cing bla na med pa'i dam tshig gi gtso bor gyur pas sngags kyi rnal 'byor la spyod pa rnams kyis 'bad pas sgrub cing bsten dgos par gdams pa'ang gzhung 'di nyid las/ de phyir gsang ba'i rgyud chen po: mtha' dag kun gyi snying po'i bcud: mchog gi rdzas kyi sbyor ba 'di: rnal 'byor rnams kyis 'bad de sgrubs: thun drug bzhi'am re re'am: dkar nag phyogs kyi tshes gcig la: sngags pas rab tu bsten bya ste: sangs rgyas dam tshig mchog tu gsung : de ltar grol ba bla med pa: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ril bu ni: zung 'jug ye shes mchog 'grub pa'i: lam gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag go /zhes legs par gsungs pa ltar blo ldan rnams kyis tshul 'di la cis kyang 'bad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas mtshams sbyor spyi 'gro bcas shis brjod ni/ oṃ: dge ba 'di yis bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bde ba mchog dang mnyam sbyor bas: thun mong dngos grub dka' ba med par 'thob pa dang : mchog gi ye shes myur du 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs las yang dag byung gyur cing : bde chen bdud rtsis brtan g.yo'i dngos kun khyab par mdzad: zhi khro 'dus pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis: 'byung po kun la rtag tu dge legs sbyin gyur cig:

de lta bu'i bdud rtsi sman gyi dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i phan yon kyang gzhung las/ dbang 'dir gang gis 'brel pa kun: mtshams med las kyang kun byang nas: rig 'dzin grub pa mchog rnams dang : skal ba mnyam pa kho na'o: zhes gsungs pas mtshon no/ /gnyis pa las thun mong du sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams sbyin pa la/ rdo rje'i dgang blugs gtad pas phrin las rnam bzhi myur du 'grub par byed pa sreg pa me'i phrin las la mnga' dbang 'byor par mos shig /dgang blugs gtad la/ oṃ: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i phrin las kyis: rang dang gzhan don rdzogs pa'i phyir: rdo rje me yi sbyor ba yis: zhi dang rgyas dang dbang mngon spyod: bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i: ye shes thams cad sgrub par gyis: badz+ra a na la sarba karma ku ru hoḥ las spyi dang bye brag pa rnams la so so'i gdams ngag kyang 'bogs par gsungs pas lcogs na dbang rnams kyi rjes so sor sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung tsam sprel na legs par snang ngo*/

/chos kyi dung dang dril bu glegs bam rnams phyag tu gtad pas skal ldan gyi slob ma rjes su bzung zhing 'gro don ris su ma chad par spyod pa'i dbang bskur thob par mos shig /deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis: bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i dung bus la: chos kyi dril bu'i sgra chen pos: sems can khams rnams sad par gyis: badz+ra bhā ṣa ghāṇ+ḍe dharma tsakra ku ru hoḥ zhes rjes gnang rnams byin nas/ de ltar na de dag rnams kyi sgo nas bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i smin byed rtsa ba yan lag bcas legs par grub pa lags pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bo khyod kyis gang gsung pa: de ltar bdag gis rab tu gzung : srog la bab kyang sgrub lags na: rtag tu byin gyis brlab mdzad gsol: lan gsum/ dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ lus longs spyod ltos pa med par 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: bdag ni gtso bo khyed kyi 'bangs: lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang : cha shas spyad cing bzhes mdzad gsol: lan gsum/ dpon slob thun mong du tshogs kyi dga' ston la longs spyod/ sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i skabs mar me smon lam dbyangs bor len gyi tshul du bya/ mtshams sbyor spyi mthun bcas zhal nas gsungs pas thog drangs shis brjod rgyas par spel/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon byas la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /gsum pa rjes su bya ba'i las kyi rim pa la dbang gi rjes rim song grub/ cho ga'i rjes bya ni/ slob dpon gyis tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang*/ sngags srung ma'i gsham las 'byung ba ltar gtor 'bul/ chad tho/ /brtan ma bskyang ba rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' las byung

sogs sngags rnams dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig bya/ nongs bshags dang yig brgya brjod/ ye shes pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldangs bsngo smon shis brjod bcas kyis legs par 'grub bo/ /'brel tshad rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che'i/ /rig mchog phyag rgya'i ye shes 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /bden tshig bslu ba med pas bdag gzhan kun/ /mchog dngos gang de tshe 'dir myur 'grub shog /ces zab chos smin grol gyi bgo skal thog ma'i snod du gyur pa'i skal pa bzang po dang*/ bsnyen sgrub nyams len yid bde'i dpyid du thob pa rtsis bral gyi rnal 'byor pa pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis/ gter chen bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes dang gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ji lta bar bltas chog gi lag len tu tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ /slar yang bdag phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas spyi lo 2008 bod zla dang por bka' babs skor bskyar bsgrig skabs yig chung rnams la 'byin 'jug cung zad bcas nag 'gros su bgyis pa ste cho ga la thugs rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing*/ dge bas bdag 'dra blun po rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // PAGE PAGE 29 FILENAME T-15.doc
